description: The executable cross-SDK parity surface (#392). Each area lists the goldens any SDK must reproduce from the named inputs via the canonical operation, plus per-SDK coverage. Conformance = both SDKs reproduce every golden from its input (the per-fixture reproduction tests: Python tests/test_contracts_*, TypeScript packages/typescript/temporal/test/*). Interfaces (#616) are the second contract class: normative surface documents that servers conform to and clients are generated from. This file is the index + the suite-integrity gate; it does not replace those tests.

fixtures.note: {value, canonical} pairs spanning the fixed/scientific + big-int boundaries

areas.name: prompt-ref
areas.operation: PromptRef.to_dict() == golden (prompt_type is a resolve-time hint, not serialized)

areas.name: manifest
areas.operation: schema_hash(input)/messages_hash + execution manifests reproduce the goldens

interfaces.name: resolver
interfaces.description: The transport-shaped resolution interface: the one language-bound control-plane layer, returning control-plane contract DTOs (response schemas cross-checked against the OpenAPI document by the suite-integrity gates).

interfaces.name: temporal-binding
interfaces.description: Normative Temporal binding profiles: the shared operate-tier wire surface (memo keys, signal/query names, payload conventions) plus the two deliberately divergent execution ABIs (python-versioned-type, ts-plan-argument). Per-SDK conformance tests assert exported constants against this document.

interfaces.name: controlplane
interfaces.description: Normative control-plane HTTP API (OpenAPI 3.1). Servers conform to it; clients are generated from it. Unlike areas, an interface is a surface document, not a golden-reproduction fixture. Conformer status lives in controlplane/README.md.
